name: high-quality-projects-skill
description: Production-oriented project discovery and code standards for any coding agent. project_setup runs a multi-round Grill Me interview, confirms users, scope, brand, signing, distribution, service, security, operations and release decisions, then scaffolds strict quality gates. quality_retrofit brings existing codebases into compliance in reviewable phases. Both scan before writing and preserve existing config. The workflows are vendor-neutral Markdown; this manifest is Claude Code packaging only.
